entry.title: FAW, Toyota, and GAC Begin New JV Chapter by Signing Strategic Alliance Framework Agreement
entry.content: China FAW Corporation Limited (FAW), Toyota Motor Corporation (Toyota), and Guangzhou Automobile Group Co., Ltd. (GAC) held a signing ceremony here today for a framework agreement on a new strategic alliance. FAW President Liu Yigong, Toyota President Kenta Kon, and GAC Chairman Feng Xingya represented their respective companies at the ceremony.

entry.title: TOYOTA RACING reacts to Mike Conway’s retirement
entry.content: TOYOTA RACING pays a heartfelt tribute to its driver and team-mate Mike Conway, who will retire from full-time competition at the end of the 2026 FIA World Endurance Championship (WEC) season. The British driver has played a significant role in the team’s development and success since joining in 2014, helping TOYOTA to seven manufacturers’ World Championships.
